October 31, 2026


Recently our Indigenous Engagement team and one of our Community Liaisons represented Cameco at the English River Career Fair in Patuanak, chatting with students and community members about careers at Cameco, scholarships, training programs and pathways for career development. These conversations are an important part of our work in helping build awareness of opportunities available across northern Saskatchewan and supporting the next generation as they explore their futures. #NorthernSaskatchewan #CareerDevelopment[#CareerOpportunities](https://facebook.com/hashtag/CareerOpportunities)
